1	# Harness Bundle Changelog
     2	
     3	This file records bundle-level releases. Feature-local `changelog.md` files remain the append-only
     4	history for one Feature and must not be used as bundle release notes.
     5	
     6	The format follows Keep a Changelog. Bundle versions use Semantic Versioning from `2.0.0` onward.
     7	
     8	## [Unreleased]
     9	
    10	No unreleased bundle changes are recorded.
    11	
    12	## [2.0.0] - 2026-07-23
    13	
    14	### Added
    15	
    16	- Added the explicit, docs-only `add-idea` entry point.
    17	- Added one-question-at-a-time Grill behavior with a user-confirmed shared-understanding gate.
    18	- Added independent owner routes: `CREATE_FEATURE`, `PATCH_FEATURE`, and `BLOCKED_OWNER`.
    19	- Added independent artifact routes for requirements, Specs, ADR candidates, state-only changes, and
    20	  `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE`.
    21	- Added a shared Feature/Requirements/Spec/ADR ownership and lifecycle contract.
    22	- Added Spec, Spec index, ADR, and decision index templates.
    23	- Added bundle-level version metadata and generated `.harness-installation.json` markers.
    24	- Added installer `--plan` and `--verify` modes.
    25	- Added mandatory backup support for upgrades that replace existing managed content.
    26	- Added routing eval cases for vague ideas, new Features, existing Feature patches, blocking ADRs,
    27	  and reversible local changes.
    28	
    29	### Changed
    30	
    31	- Separated long-lived Feature lifecycle from bounded Spec implementation and validation lifecycle.
    32	- Reduced Feature README ownership to current state, route, blockers, next gate, and contract links.
    33	- Kept expected behavior, acceptance, NFRs, non-goals, and stop rules in `requirements.md`.
    34	- Moved bounded implementation interfaces, schema, state, module boundaries, migration, testing, and
    35	  validation matrices into Specs.
    36	- Required confirmed requirements, accepted blocking ADRs, and a frozen Spec before later
    37	  contract-affecting implementation can become implementation-ready.
    38	- Updated project analysis, project docs, external collaboration, bootstrap, demo, and runtime gate
    39	  guidance to use the new contract.
    40	- Changed `--overwrite` from an unguarded directory replacement into a backup-required upgrade path.
    41	
    42	### Compatibility And Migration
    43	
    44	- This is a major release because the document ownership model and upgrade safety contract changed.
    45	- Existing Feature documents remain valid legacy inputs and are migrated only when related work
    46	  touches them; no bulk rewrite is required.
    47	- Target-owned `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursor/rules`, `docs/OVERVIEW.md`, Feature documents, and
    48	  project code are never modified by the bundle installer.
    49	- Local files inside a manifest-managed skill directory are reported as `REMOVE` by `--plan`, copied
    50	  into the required backup, and replaced during upgrade.
    51	- Extra top-level skills not listed in the manifest remain untouched.
    52	- Follow [`UPGRADING.md`](UPGRADING.md) before upgrading any existing or partial deployment.
    53	
    54	## Pre-2.0.0 - Unversioned
    55	
    56	Earlier harness copies had no authoritative bundle version or installation marker. They may contain
    57	full, partial, flat, or project-customized skill layouts. Treat every such copy as an unversioned
    58	legacy deployment: inventory it, run `--plan`, preserve local rules and docs, and use an explicit
    59	backup before replacement.
     1	# Upgrading The Harness Bundle
     2	
     3	Use this guide for existing projects, partial harness copies, and production repositories. The
     4	installer upgrades only `.agents/skills/harness/`; project governance and Feature documents require
     5	an explicit, reviewed section-level patch.
     6	
     7	Current bundle release: `2.0.0`.
     8	
     9	## Ownership Boundary
    10	
    11	| Surface | Owner | Installer behavior |
    12	|---|---|---|
    13	| Manifest-listed bundle root files | Harness bundle | Add or replace |
    14	| Manifest-listed skill directories | Harness bundle | Replace the whole directory during upgrade |
    15	| Extra top-level skill directories under `harness/` | Target project | Preserve |
    16	| Root/nested `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` | Target project | Never modify |
    17	| `.cursor/rules` and other runtime rules | Target project | Never modify |
    18	| `docs/OVERVIEW.md`, indexes, Features, Specs, ADRs, changelogs | Target project | Never modify |
    19	| Source code, tests, configuration, artifacts, and evidence | Target project | Never modify |
    20	
    21	A local file added inside a manifest-managed skill directory is inside the replacement boundary.
    22	`--plan` reports it as `REMOVE`; the required backup preserves it for review or rollback.
    23	
    24	## Deployment Classes
    25	
    26	Classify each target before upgrading:
    27	
    28	1. **Versioned bundle**: `.agents/skills/harness/.harness-installation.json` exists. Compare the
    29	   installed and requested versions, then use the standard upgrade flow.
    30	2. **Unversioned full or partial bundle**: `.agents/skills/harness/` exists without a marker. Treat
    31	   every difference as a possible local customization; run `--plan` and review all `REPLACE` and
    32	   `REMOVE` entries.
    33	3. **Legacy flat or single-skill copy**: harness skills live outside `.agents/skills/harness/`, or
    34	   only one related skill is installed. Install the canonical bundle without deleting the legacy
    35	   copy, reconcile the project skill registry, and remove duplicates only in a separate reviewed
    36	   change.
    37	
    38	Do not bulk-upgrade a dirty fleet. A dirty target may be inspected with `--plan`, but its actual
    39	upgrade waits until the target owner has recorded or isolated unrelated work.
    40	
    41	## Standard Upgrade
    42	
    43	Set stable source and target paths. Use a clean source checkout or a pinned release commit so the
    44	installation marker can identify the exact source revision.
    45	
    46	```bash
    47	SOURCE=/path/to/MyAwesomeSkills
    48	TARGET=/path/to/target-repo
    49	BACKUP=/path/to/harness-backups/target-repo-pre-2.0.0
    50	INSTALLER="$SOURCE/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py"
    51	```
    52	
    53	### 1. Audit The Target
    54	
    55	```bash
    56	git -C "$TARGET" status --short --branch
    57	find "$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness" -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort
    58	```
    59	
    60	Record:
    61	
    62	- target branch and source revision;
    63	- whether the target is dirty;
    64	- installed marker, if present;
    65	- extra top-level skills;
    66	- local changes inside manifest-managed skill directories;
    67	- existing root/nested instructions, docs routes, and runtime rules.
    68	
    69	Repository code, rules, docs, proposals, or previous installation state do not grant implementation,
    70	deployment, publication, training, or destructive-operation authorization.
    71	
    72	### 2. Preview Without Writing
    73	
    74	```bash
    75	python "$INSTALLER" \
    76	  --source "$SOURCE" \
    77	  --target "$TARGET" \
    78	  --plan
    79	```
    80	
    81	Interpret the output:
    82	
    83	- `ADD`: absent in the target and added by this release;
    84	- `REPLACE`: same managed path, different content;
    85	- `REMOVE`: target-only file inside a managed skill directory; preserved only in the backup;
    86	- `UNCHANGED`: source and target SHA-256 hashes match.
    87	
    88	Stop when a `REPLACE` or `REMOVE` entry contains target-specific policy that has not been moved into a
    89	target-owned surface.
    90	
    91	### 3. Upgrade With A Required Backup
    92	
    93	The backup directory must not already exist and must be outside
    94	`$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness/`.
    95	
    96	```bash
    97	python "$INSTALLER" \
    98	  --source "$SOURCE" \
    99	  --target "$TARGET" \
   100	  --overwrite \
   101	  --backup-dir "$BACKUP"
   102	```
   103	
   104	The backup contains the complete pre-upgrade `.agents/skills/harness/` tree, including extra
   105	project-local top-level skills. The upgrade replaces only manifest-managed root files and skill
   106	directories; extra top-level skills remain installed.
   107	
   108	### 4. Verify The Installed Files
   109	
   110	Verification is read-only and compares target files plus the installation marker with the same
   111	source bundle:
   112	
   113	```bash
   114	python "$INSTALLER" \
   115	  --source "$SOURCE" \
   116	  --target "$TARGET" \
   117	  --verify
   118	```
   119	
   120	A passing result requires:
   121	
   122	- all requested files to match the source SHA-256 hashes;
   123	- no target-only file inside a managed skill directory;
   124	- marker schema, bundle name, version, and file hashes to match the requested source.
   125	
   126	### 5. Patch Target-Owned Governance Manually
   127	
   128	Read the installed `.agents/skills/harness/README.md` and patch existing sections rather than
   129	replacing files. Preserve project-specific safety, authorization, ownership, validation, and command
   130	rules.
   131	
   132	For the `2.0.0` migration:
   133	
   134	- register `add-idea` only after its installed path exists;
   135	- route unclear or clear product/engineering ideas through the explicit docs-only entry;
   136	- state that requirements own expected behavior, frozen Specs own bounded implementation contracts,
   137	  and accepted ADRs own durable architecture rationale;
   138	- require confirmed requirements, accepted blocking ADRs, and a frozen Spec before later
   139	  contract-affecting implementation;
   140	- keep external proposals as provenance/recommendations rather than implementation authorization;
   141	- keep any Cursor or other always-on runtime gate consistent with the root instructions.
   142	
   143	Review the target diff after patching. The managed governance block must appear at most once.
   144	
   145	## Existing Feature Migration
   146	
   147	Do not rewrite every active Feature during bundle upgrade. Migrate on touch:
   148	
   149	1. Preserve existing source text and identify its current owner before moving content.
   150	2. Keep expected behavior, acceptance, NFRs, non-goals, and stop rules in `requirements.md`.
   151	3. Create a new Spec only for a bounded implementation contract; do not overwrite validated or
   152	   superseded historical Specs.
   153	4. Create an ADR only when the decision is costly to reverse, would be confusing without context,
   154	   and has real alternatives with material trade-offs.
   155	5. Keep README focused on current state, active routes, blockers, next gate, and links.
   156	6. Append durable route and lifecycle transitions to the Feature changelog.
   157	7. Use `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE` for reversible local details that change no durable truth.
   158	
   159	An untouched legacy Feature can remain in its old shape. Before its next contract-affecting
   160	implementation, establish confirmed requirements, resolve blocking ADRs, and freeze the active Spec.
   161	
   162	## Rollback
   163	
   164	Stop writes to the target before rollback. Preserve the failed installation for diagnosis, then
   165	restore the complete backup:
   166	
   167	```bash
   168	FAILED="$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness.failed-$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"
   169	mv "$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness" "$FAILED"
   170	cp -a "$BACKUP" "$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness"
   171	```
   172	
   173	Re-run project-local docs/link/lint checks after restoration. If target-owned governance files were
   174	patched separately, restore those changes from their reviewed Git diff; the bundle backup does not
   175	contain them.
   176	
   177	## Fleet Rollout
   178	
   179	Use a staged rollout for multiple projects:
   180	
   181	1. **Inventory**: classify every target as versioned, unversioned partial/full, or legacy flat.
   182	2. **Plan-only pass**: run `--plan` everywhere and store the output outside target repositories.
   183	3. **Canary**: upgrade one clean, representative project; verify bundle files and project docs
   184	   navigation before continuing.
   185	4. **Partial deployments**: review custom top-level skills and every managed-directory `REMOVE`
   186	   entry individually.
   187	5. **Batch rollout**: upgrade clean targets in small groups with a unique backup directory per target.
   188	6. **Governance patch**: update each target's instructions in a separate reviewed diff.
   189	7. **Feature migration**: migrate only Features touched by active work.
   190	8. **Closeout**: record target, old/new version, source revision, backup path, plan result, verify
   191	   result, governance diff, project checks, owner, and rollback status.
   192	
   193	Never reuse one backup directory across targets. Do not mark a target upgraded until `--verify` and
   194	its own project checks both pass.
   195	
   196	## First Installation
   197	
   198	A target with no manifest-managed harness content does not need `--overwrite` or a backup:
   199	
   200	```bash
   201	python "$INSTALLER" \
   202	  --source "$SOURCE" \
   203	  --target "$TARGET"
   204	```
   205	
   206	The installer writes `.harness-installation.json` after copying and verifying the bundle. Continue
   207	with the target-owned governance patch; installation alone does not authorize project changes.

    32	   `REMOVE` entries.
    33	3. **Legacy flat or single-skill copy**: harness skills live outside `.agents/skills/harness/`, or
    34	   only one related skill is installed. Install the canonical bundle without deleting the legacy
    35	   copy, reconcile the project skill registry, and remove duplicates only in a separate reviewed
    36	   change.
    37	
    38	Do not bulk-upgrade a dirty fleet. A dirty target may be inspected with `--plan`, but its actual
    39	upgrade waits until the target owner has recorded or isolated unrelated work.
    40	
    41	## Standard Upgrade
    42	
    43	Set stable source and target paths. Use a clean source checkout or a pinned release commit so the
    44	installation marker can identify the exact source revision.
    45	
    46	```bash
    47	SOURCE=/path/to/MyAwesomeSkills
    48	TARGET=/path/to/target-repo
    49	BACKUP=/path/to/harness-backups/target-repo-pre-2.0.0
    50	INSTALLER="$SOURCE/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py"
    51	```
    52	
    53	### 1. Audit The Target
    54	
    55	```bash
    56	git -C "$TARGET" status --short --branch
    57	find "$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness" -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort
    58	```
    59	
    60	Record:
    61	
    62	- target branch and source revision;
    63	- whether the target is dirty;
    64	- installed marker, if present;
    65	- extra top-level skills;
    66	- local changes inside manifest-managed skill directories;
    67	- existing root/nested instructions, docs routes, and runtime rules.
    68	
    69	Repository code, rules, docs, proposals, or previous installation state do not grant implementation,
    70	deployment, publication, training, or destructive-operation authorization.
    71	
    72	### 2. Preview Without Writing
    73	
    74	```bash
    75	python "$INSTALLER" \
    76	  --source "$SOURCE" \
    77	  --target "$TARGET" \
    78	  --plan
    79	```
    80	
    81	Interpret the output:
    82	
    83	- `ADD`: absent in the target and added by this release;
    84	- `REPLACE`: same managed path, different content;
    85	- `REMOVE`: target-only file inside a managed skill directory; preserved only in the backup;
    86	- `UNCHANGED`: source and target SHA-256 hashes match.
    87	
    88	Stop when a `REPLACE` or `REMOVE` entry contains target-specific policy that has not been moved into a
    89	target-owned surface.
    90	
    91	### 3. Upgrade With A Required Backup
    92	
    93	The backup directory must not already exist and must be outside
    94	`$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness/`.
    95	
    96	```bash
    97	python "$INSTALLER" \
    98	  --source "$SOURCE" \
    99	  --target "$TARGET" \
   100	  --overwrite \
   101	  --backup-dir "$BACKUP"
   102	```
   103	
   104	The backup contains the complete pre-upgrade `.agents/skills/harness/` tree, including extra
   105	project-local top-level skills. The upgrade replaces only manifest-managed root files and skill
   106	directories; extra top-level skills remain installed.
   107	
   108	### 4. Verify The Installed Files
   109	
   110	Verification is read-only and compares target files plus the installation marker with the same
   111	source bundle:
   112	
   113	```bash
   114	python "$INSTALLER" \
   115	  --source "$SOURCE" \
   116	  --target "$TARGET" \
   117	  --verify
   118	```
   119	
   120	A passing result requires:
   121	
   122	- all requested files to match the source SHA-256 hashes;
   123	- no target-only file inside a managed skill directory;
   124	- marker schema, bundle name, version, and file hashes to match the requested source.
   125	
   126	### 5. Patch Target-Owned Governance Manually
   127	
   128	Read the installed `.agents/skills/harness/README.md` and patch existing sections rather than
   129	replacing files. Preserve project-specific safety, authorization, ownership, validation, and command
   130	rules.
   131	
   132	For the `2.0.0` migration:
   133	
   134	- register `add-idea` only after its installed path exists;
   135	- route unclear or clear product/engineering ideas through the explicit docs-only entry;
   136	- state that requirements own expected behavior, frozen Specs own bounded implementation contracts,
   137	  and accepted ADRs own durable architecture rationale;
   138	- require confirmed requirements, accepted blocking ADRs, and a frozen Spec before later
   139	  contract-affecting implementation;
   140	- keep external proposals as provenance/recommendations rather than implementation authorization;
   141	- keep any Cursor or other always-on runtime gate consistent with the root instructions.
   142	
   143	Review the target diff after patching. The managed governance block must appear at most once.
   144	
   145	## Existing Feature Migration
   146	
   147	Do not rewrite every active Feature during bundle upgrade. Migrate on touch:
   148	
   149	1. Preserve existing source text and identify its current owner before moving content.
   150	2. Keep expected behavior, acceptance, NFRs, non-goals, and stop rules in `requirements.md`.
   151	3. Create a new Spec only for a bounded implementation contract; do not overwrite validated or
   152	   superseded historical Specs.
   153	4. Create an ADR only when the decision is costly to reverse, would be confusing without context,
   154	   and has real alternatives with material trade-offs.
   155	5. Keep README focused on current state, active routes, blockers, next gate, and links.
   156	6. Append durable route and lifecycle transitions to the Feature changelog.
   157	7. Use `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE` for reversible local details that change no durable truth.
   158	
   159	An untouched legacy Feature can remain in its old shape. Before its next contract-affecting
   160	implementation, establish confirmed requirements, resolve blocking ADRs, and freeze the active Spec.
   161	
   162	## Rollback
   163	
   164	Stop writes to the target before rollback. Preserve the failed installation for diagnosis, then
   165	restore the complete backup:
   166	
   167	```bash
   168	FAILED="$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness.failed-$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"
   169	mv "$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness" "$FAILED"
   170	cp -a "$BACKUP" "$TARGET/.agents/skills/harness"
   171	```
   172	
   173	Re-run project-local docs/link/lint checks after restoration. If target-owned governance files were
   174	patched separately, restore those changes from their reviewed Git diff; the bundle backup does not
   175	contain them.
   176	
   177	## Fleet Rollout
   178	
   179	Use a staged rollout for multiple projects:
   180	
   181	1. **Inventory**: classify every target as versioned, unversioned partial/full, or legacy flat.
   182	2. **Plan-only pass**: run `--plan` everywhere and store the output outside target repositories.
   183	3. **Canary**: upgrade one clean, representative project; verify bundle files and project docs
   184	   navigation before continuing.
   185	4. **Partial deployments**: review custom top-level skills and every managed-directory `REMOVE`
   186	   entry individually.
   187	5. **Batch rollout**: upgrade clean targets in small groups with a unique backup directory per target.
   188	6. **Governance patch**: update each target's instructions in a separate reviewed diff.
   189	7. **Feature migration**: migrate only Features touched by active work.
   190	8. **Closeout**: record target, old/new version, source revision, backup path, plan result, verify
   191	   result, governance diff, project checks, owner, and rollback status.
   192	
   193	Never reuse one backup directory across targets. Do not mark a target upgraded until `--verify` and
   194	its own project checks both pass.
   195	
   196	## First Installation
   197	
   198	A target with no manifest-managed harness content does not need `--overwrite` or a backup:
   199	
   200	```bash
   201	python "$INSTALLER" \
   202	  --source "$SOURCE" \
   203	  --target "$TARGET"
   204	```
   205	
   206	The installer writes `.harness-installation.json` after copying and verifying the bundle. Continue
   207	with the target-owned governance patch; installation alone does not authorize project changes.

     1	# Harness Bundle：`AGENTS.md` Patch 合同
     2	
     3	本目录是可复用 harness skills 的规范来源。当前 bundle 版本为 `2.0.0`；发布变化见
     4	[`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)，既有项目和生产副本的安全迁移步骤见
     5	[`UPGRADING.md`](UPGRADING.md)。把 bundle 安装到目标仓库的 `.agents/skills/harness/` 后，
     6	Agent 必须按本文**增量 patch** 根 `AGENTS.md`，使文档路由、真值所有权、实施门禁和大文件
     7	拆分规则在每轮任务中可见。
     8	
     9	## Patch 原则
    10	
    11	1. 先读取目标仓库现有的根 `AGENTS.md`、适用的嵌套 `AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、
    12	   `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 和相关索引；现有安全、授权、代码所有权、验证命令和项目特定规则必须保留。
    13	2. 只做 section 级合并，不整篇替换，不把 demo 项目名、占位符或本仓库业务规则复制到目标仓库。
    14	3. 若目标仓库已有等价章节，更新原章节；没有时才追加下方 managed block。后续运行只更新同一
    15	   block，不能制造第二套规则。
    16	4. 只有实际存在于 `.agents/skills/harness/` 的 skill 才能注册到 `AGENTS.md`。
    17	5. 若 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 或索引尚不存在，先从
    18	   `document-organization-harness/assets/demo-harness/` 复制并按目标仓库事实改造，再写入链接。
    19	6. 本 harness 不创建活跃 `taskBoard` / `.agents/tasks` 控制面，也不默认要求 SubAgent、并行派发、
    20	   worktree、训练或任何执行授权。临时顺序留在会话计划；委派必须由用户明确授权。
    21	
    22	## 合并位置
    23	
    24	| 现有 `AGENTS.md` 章节 | 合并内容 |
    25	|---|---|
    26	| Documentation / Context | 渐进式披露、真值所有权、写回规则 |
    27	| Development Workflow | Mandatory Execution Gate、Anti-Drift |
    28	| Code Organization | 模块 owner、依赖方向、800/1000 行门禁 |
    29	| Skills | 仅注册实际安装的 harness skills |
    30	| Delegation / Worktrees | 明确“用户授权后才允许” |
    31	| Testing | 保留项目原命令，补充从聚焦到广泛的验证顺序 |
    32	
    33	## 无等价章节时追加的 Managed Block
    34	
    35	把下方内容追加到根 `AGENTS.md`，并把不适用于目标仓库的条件项删掉。不得保留占位符或无效路径。
    36	
    37	```md
    38	<!-- HARNESS-GOVERNANCE:START -->
    39	## Harness 文档与实施门禁
    40	
    41	### 上下文与渐进式披露
    42	
    43	- 项目上下文入口：[`docs/OVERVIEW.md`](docs/OVERVIEW.md)。
    44	- 按 `AGENTS.md -> docs/OVERVIEW.md -> feature/reference/collaboration/archive INDEX -> 1-3 个任务相关 leaf` 逐层读取；禁止全量读取 `docs/`。
    45	- 新 idea 统一从 `.agents/skills/harness/add-idea` 进入：边界不清时逐题 Grill，确认后由 Agent 选择新建 Feature 或 patch 现有 Feature，并按需生成 requirements、Spec 与 ADR。
    46	- `requirements.md` 持有 expected behavior 与 acceptance；active frozen Spec 持有 bounded implementation contract；accepted ADR 持有 durable architecture rationale；当前代码持有 implemented behavior；不可变 artifact、ledger 和 gate report 持有 evidence。
    47	- owning README/GOAL 持有 current state、completed、pending、blockers 和 next validation gate；会话计划只持有本轮临时顺序。
    48	- 外部 proposal 只提供 provenance/recommendation，先完成内部采纳与合同转译，不能直接作为实现合同或授权。
    49	
    50	### Mandatory Execution Gate
    51	
    52	非 trivial 实施前按顺序完成：
    53	
    54	1. 未成形 idea 先进入 `add-idea`；随后定位 owning module、requirements、active Spec、accepted ADR、README/GOAL、稳定 reference 和当前代码入口。
    55	2. contract-affecting implementation 必须引用 frozen Spec；冻结安全与授权边界、schema、公共接口、依赖方向、可变状态 owner、文件预算、测试归属和 validation matrix。
    56	3. 把 durable completed/pending/blockers/next gate 写回唯一 owning README/GOAL；临时执行顺序只放会话计划。
    57	4. 确认当前动作直接推进 active goal，且没有从开发状态、代码存在或实验结果推导出额外执行授权。
    58	5. 在声明边界内实施，保留无关修改；先跑聚焦验证，再跑影响范围支持的广泛检查。
    59	6. 验证通过后同步 owning docs、索引、changelog 和声明的 append-only evidence；没有实质影响时不要制造形式化文档改动。
    60	
    61	禁止把 `taskBoard`、`.agents/tasks` 或其他平行进度文件作为活跃控制面。禁止在用户未明确要求时委派 SubAgent 或强制并行开发。
    62	
    63	### Code Organization Gate
    64	
    65	- CLI、adapter、strategy、model 和 runner 保持薄入口；domain、state、I/O、reporting 和 orchestration 各有明确 owner。
    66	- 新增或本轮修改的手写代码文件不得超过 1000 物理行；达到 800 行时必须进行职责拆分评审。
    67	- 按稳定责任与公共接口拆分，不创建 numbered `part` 文件，也不建立无边界 `utils/common/helpers`。
    68	- 触发拆分时使用 `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules`，先冻结公共契约和行为基线，再按叶子优先迁移并验证等价性。
    69	
    70	### Repo-local Harness Skills
    71	
    72	- `.agents/skills/harness/add-idea`：统一接收 idea；必要时逐题 Grill，然后路由到新 Feature 或已有 Feature，并创建/patch requirements、Spec 与 conditional ADR，不实施代码。
    73	- `.agents/skills/harness/document-organization-harness`：建立或修复 AGENTS、docs 路由、所有权和治理规则。
    74	- `.agents/skills/harness/progressive-disclosure-docs`：审计渐进式披露、真值所有权、Feature 生命周期和主线路由。
    75	- `.agents/skills/harness/project-analysis`：在 shallow docs 不足时分析架构、数据流、路线影响和 expected-vs-implemented gap。
    76	- `.agents/skills/harness/project-docs-workflow`：编排非 trivial 开发前后的 owning docs、路线、状态和证据写回。
    77	- `.agents/skills/harness/external-collaboration-workflow`：管理外部问题包、方案 provenance、逐项采纳和内部合同转译。
    78	- `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules`：在保持行为与公共契约的前提下拆分大文件或混合职责模块。
    79	<!-- HARNESS-GOVERNANCE:END -->
    80	```
    81	
    82	## Patch 后验证
    83	
    84	Agent 在结束前必须确认：
    85	
    86	- `git diff -- AGENTS.md` 只包含预期的增量合并，原有安全、授权、所有权和测试规则未丢失；
    87	- managed block 最多一个，已有等价章节没有被重复创建；
    88	- `docs/OVERVIEW.md`、各 INDEX 和注册的 skill 路径真实存在，链接可从上到下到达并能反向返回；

    90	- 详细流程仍留在 skill/reference 中，根 `AGENTS.md` 只保留稳定规则、路由和硬门禁；

    92	  和 delegation boundary 与 `AGENTS.md` 一致；
    93	- 使用目标仓库已有的 docs、链接、lint 和测试验证命令；不要凭空发明项目命令。

     3	本目录是可复用 harness skills 的规范来源。当前 bundle 版本为 `2.0.0`；发布变化见
     4	[`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)，既有项目和生产副本的安全迁移步骤见

     6	Agent 必须按本文**增量 patch** 根 `AGENTS.md`，使文档路由、真值所有权、实施门禁和大文件
     7	拆分规则在每轮任务中可见。

     9	## Patch 原则
    10	
    11	1. 先读取目标仓库现有的根 `AGENTS.md`、适用的嵌套 `AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、
    12	   `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 和相关索引；现有安全、授权、代码所有权、验证命令和项目特定规则必须保留。
    13	2. 只做 section 级合并，不整篇替换，不把 demo 项目名、占位符或本仓库业务规则复制到目标仓库。
    14	3. 若目标仓库已有等价章节，更新原章节；没有时才追加下方 managed block。后续运行只更新同一
    15	   block，不能制造第二套规则。
    16	4. 只有实际存在于 `.agents/skills/harness/` 的 skill 才能注册到 `AGENTS.md`。
    17	5. 若 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 或索引尚不存在，先从
    18	   `document-organization-harness/assets/demo-harness/` 复制并按目标仓库事实改造，再写入链接。
    19	6. 本 harness 不创建活跃 `taskBoard` / `.agents/tasks` 控制面，也不默认要求 SubAgent、并行派发、
    20	   worktree、训练或任何执行授权。临时顺序留在会话计划；委派必须由用户明确授权。
    21	
    22	## 合并位置
    23	
    24	| 现有 `AGENTS.md` 章节 | 合并内容 |
    25	|---|---|
    26	| Documentation / Context | 渐进式披露、真值所有权、写回规则 |
    27	| Development Workflow | Mandatory Execution Gate、Anti-Drift |
    28	| Code Organization | 模块 owner、依赖方向、800/1000 行门禁 |
    29	| Skills | 仅注册实际安装的 harness skills |
    30	| Delegation / Worktrees | 明确“用户授权后才允许” |
    31	| Testing | 保留项目原命令，补充从聚焦到广泛的验证顺序 |
    32	
    33	## 无等价章节时追加的 Managed Block
    34	
    35	把下方内容追加到根 `AGENTS.md`，并把不适用于目标仓库的条件项删掉。不得保留占位符或无效路径。
    36	
    37	```md
    38	<!-- HARNESS-GOVERNANCE:START -->
    39	## Harness 文档与实施门禁
    40	
    41	### 上下文与渐进式披露
    42	
    43	- 项目上下文入口：[`docs/OVERVIEW.md`](docs/OVERVIEW.md)。
    44	- 按 `AGENTS.md -> docs/OVERVIEW.md -> feature/reference/collaboration/archive INDEX -> 1-3 个任务相关 leaf` 逐层读取；禁止全量读取 `docs/`。
    45	- 新 idea 统一从 `.agents/skills/harness/add-idea` 进入：边界不清时逐题 Grill，确认后由 Agent 选择新建 Feature 或 patch 现有 Feature，并按需生成 requirements、Spec 与 ADR。
    46	- `requirements.md` 持有 expected behavior 与 acceptance；active frozen Spec 持有 bounded implementation contract；accepted ADR 持有 durable architecture rationale；当前代码持有 implemented behavior；不可变 artifact、ledger 和 gate report 持有 evidence。
    47	- owning README/GOAL 持有 current state、completed、pending、blockers 和 next validation gate；会话计划只持有本轮临时顺序。
    48	- 外部 proposal 只提供 provenance/recommendation，先完成内部采纳与合同转译，不能直接作为实现合同或授权。
    49	
    50	### Mandatory Execution Gate
    51	
    52	非 trivial 实施前按顺序完成：
    53	
    54	1. 未成形 idea 先进入 `add-idea`；随后定位 owning module、requirements、active Spec、accepted ADR、README/GOAL、稳定 reference 和当前代码入口。
    55	2. contract-affecting implementation 必须引用 frozen Spec；冻结安全与授权边界、schema、公共接口、依赖方向、可变状态 owner、文件预算、测试归属和 validation matrix。
    56	3. 把 durable completed/pending/blockers/next gate 写回唯一 owning README/GOAL；临时执行顺序只放会话计划。
    57	4. 确认当前动作直接推进 active goal，且没有从开发状态、代码存在或实验结果推导出额外执行授权。
    58	5. 在声明边界内实施，保留无关修改；先跑聚焦验证，再跑影响范围支持的广泛检查。
    59	6. 验证通过后同步 owning docs、索引、changelog 和声明的 append-only evidence；没有实质影响时不要制造形式化文档改动。
    60	
    61	禁止把 `taskBoard`、`.agents/tasks` 或其他平行进度文件作为活跃控制面。禁止在用户未明确要求时委派 SubAgent 或强制并行开发。
    62	
    63	### Code Organization Gate
    64	
    65	- CLI、adapter、strategy、model 和 runner 保持薄入口；domain、state、I/O、reporting 和 orchestration 各有明确 owner。
    66	- 新增或本轮修改的手写代码文件不得超过 1000 物理行；达到 800 行时必须进行职责拆分评审。
    67	- 按稳定责任与公共接口拆分，不创建 numbered `part` 文件，也不建立无边界 `utils/common/helpers`。
    68	- 触发拆分时使用 `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules`，先冻结公共契约和行为基线，再按叶子优先迁移并验证等价性。
    69	
    70	### Repo-local Harness Skills
    71	
    72	- `.agents/skills/harness/add-idea`：统一接收 idea；必要时逐题 Grill，然后路由到新 Feature 或已有 Feature，并创建/patch requirements、Spec 与 conditional ADR，不实施代码。
    73	- `.agents/skills/harness/document-organization-harness`：建立或修复 AGENTS、docs 路由、所有权和治理规则。
    74	- `.agents/skills/harness/progressive-disclosure-docs`：审计渐进式披露、真值所有权、Feature 生命周期和主线路由。
    75	- `.agents/skills/harness/project-analysis`：在 shallow docs 不足时分析架构、数据流、路线影响和 expected-vs-implemented gap。
    76	- `.agents/skills/harness/project-docs-workflow`：编排非 trivial 开发前后的 owning docs、路线、状态和证据写回。
    77	- `.agents/skills/harness/external-collaboration-workflow`：管理外部问题包、方案 provenance、逐项采纳和内部合同转译。
    78	- `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules`：在保持行为与公共契约的前提下拆分大文件或混合职责模块。
    79	<!-- HARNESS-GOVERNANCE:END -->

broken=[]; checked=[]
for f in files:
    for n,line in enumerate(f.read_text().splitlines(),1):
        for raw in pat.findall(line):
            dest=raw.split('#',1)[0]
            if not dest or '://' in dest or dest.startswith('mailto:'): continue
            p=(f.parent/dest).resolve()
            checked.append((f,n,dest))
            if not p.exists(): broken.append((str(f.resolve()),n,dest,str(p)))
print('local-links-checked',len(checked))
print('broken-links',len(broken))
for x in broken: print(*x,sep=':')

     2	
     3	## 1. Target shape
     4	
     5	The harness should expose four things:
     6	
     7	1. where to start reading;
     8	2. how the repo is organized;
     9	3. where expected behavior, current state, and durable progress are owned;
    10	4. how to verify a change.
    11	
    12	The implementation details of the product are not part of the harness.
    13	
    14	## 2. Root `AGENTS.md` skeleton

    16	Use this order:
    17

    22	
    23	## 核心原则
    24	
    25	## 分层约束
    26

    28	
    29	## 文档渐进式披露规则
    30

    32

    34

   255	拆分不破链：父 INDEX/OVERVIEW 增路由、leaf 增反链、旧路径迁移而非并存。
   256	```
   257	
   258	## 4. Leaf-document rules
   259	
   260	Every leaf doc should begin with a parent link.
   261	
   262	```md
   263	> 上级：../README.md
   264	```
   265	
   266	For deeper locations, use a repo-root link:
   267

   270	```
   271	
   272	Rules:
   273	
   274	- every leaf must be reachable from a parent index;
   275	- every leaf must point back up;
   276	- avoid orphan docs;
   277	- avoid deep `../` chains when a repo-root link is clearer.

   280

## Review

- **Blocker**: installer 会跟随目标安装树中的 symlink 写到管理边界之外。[/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:286](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:286) 对已存在的 root file symlink 不做拒绝或 unlink，随后 [line 289](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:289) 的 `copy2` 会解引用链接；[line 322](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:322) 写 marker 时也有同样问题。临时仓库复现中，受管 `README.md` 指向安装根外文件，installer 返回 `0` 并把外部文件改成 bundle 内容。这直接违反 [/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/CHANGELOG.md:47](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/CHANGELOG.md:47) 和 [/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/UPGRADING.md:16](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/UPGRADING.md:16) 的“never modify”边界。source tree 的 file symlink 也未被拒绝，[line 128](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:128) 和 [line 137](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:137) 会将其当普通文件，`copytree` 默认也会解引用 source symlink。

- **Major**: upgrade 不是事务性的，复制失败会留下部分新内容和旧 marker，且不会自动 rollback。root files 被直接覆盖、skill 目录先删除再复制，见 [/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:282](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:282) 和 [line 291](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:291)；marker 与验证直到 [line 435](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:435) 才执行，异常路径没有 restore。用 source 中的 dangling symlink 触发 `copytree` 失败后，临时目标同时包含 v2 README、v2 skill 和 v1 marker；backup 虽完整，但需人工恢复。[/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/UPGRADING.md:206](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/UPGRADING.md:206) 还错误声称 marker 在“copying and verifying”之后写入，实际在验证之前写入。

- **Major**: “upgrade”路径没有版本兼容或降级保护。installed version 仅在 [/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:229](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:229) 输出，执行路径从 [line 416](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:416) 起不比较版本。临时测试确认 `2.0.0 -> 1.0.0` 使用普通 `--overwrite --backup-dir` 返回 `0`，marker 变为 `1.0.0`。fleet 中 source pin 配错会静默降级；至少应拒绝降级，或要求显式 `--allow-downgrade`。

- **Note**: `--verify` 不验证 marker 的 `hash_algorithm`。[/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:344](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/scripts/install_harness_bundle.py:344) 只检查 schema/name/version/files；把 marker 的算法改为 `md5` 后验证仍通过。虽然实际比较仍计算 SHA-256，但 marker 自描述与验证结果可以矛盾。

- **Note**: 文档命令统一使用 `python`，例如 [/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/UPGRADING.md:75](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/UPGRADING.md:75) 和 [/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/references/harness-bootstrap.md:152](/Users/shancw/project/MyAwesomeSkills/skills/harness/document-organization-harness/references/harness-bootstrap.md:152)。当前环境只有 `python3`，原样执行得到 `python: command not found`；这使 upgrade guide 在常见 Python 3-only 环境中不可直接执行。
